derivations.claim: Any randomized selector over the two frozen BO1 video arms has expected imaging score bounded by the pointwise-max certificate.
assumptions: Fixed saved source scores and two output videos per source
Nonnegative selection probabilities summing to one
steps: Each convex combination is at most the maximum of its two values.
derivations.scope: Finite exposed cohort and frozen output set, not new seeds or within-video actions.
derivations.implication: Do not train another UB1/UB2 whole-video selector.

derivations.claim: With fixed feature design Phi and matched exact OLS readout, support gain depends only on Qd with Q=I-Phi Phi+.
assumptions: Same weighted vectorized data and gate operator
Real arithmetic, no regularization, exact minimum-norm OLS
steps: If d is in col(Phi), Qd=0 and matched gain is0.
derivations.scope: Ideal diagnostic class; not actual ridge/randomized-SVD/BF16 R256 optimum.
derivations.implication: Separate compensation-fit slack from support-specific structural value.

derivations.claim: Training-only matched OLS refit changes validation output by d_V-Phi_V Phi_T+ d_T.
assumptions: Minimum-norm OLS solved on training set only
No validation refit or feature fitting
steps: Subtract the two training coefficient solutions.
Apply the coefficient difference to validation features.
Expand validation squared-error advantage on the resulting delta.
derivations.scope: Exact real-arithmetic matched-refit comparison; old pipeline exposure still limits generalization.
derivations.implication: Do not project away validation errors using validation labels.

derivations.claim: PSD support Gram gives a cheap linear relaxation upper bound over a finite equal-budget swap neighborhood.
assumptions: Fixed real additive projected group contributions
steps: Maximize the remaining linear score via sorted add/remove scores over k=0..q.
Individual-negative swaps may jointly improve: e=(1,0),d1=(-.75,1),d2=(-.75,-1).
derivations.scope: Proxy neighborhood only; not a native/global impossibility certificate without a discrepancy bound.
derivations.implication: Prune hopeless proxy neighborhoods before forming a full Gram; keep joint interactions.

derivations.claim: For d_native=d_proxy+eta, advantage discrepancy is bounded by2||e+d_proxy||||eta||+||eta||^2.
assumptions: Same fixed baseline error and output metric
steps: Expand difference of the two squared errors.
derivations.scope: Per-candidate bound; uniform claims require a valid uniform eta bound.
derivations.implication: Compare predicted gain with numerical discrepancy instead of assuming QDQ commutes.

derivations.claim: Output regression information and support-action information differ; conditional residual/action cross-moments can predict gains even with E[e|h]=0.
assumptions: Action executes a real main-path change d, possibly using information not observed by the router
steps: Independent h,u in +/-1; e=u,d=hu gives zero conditional mean error and exactly predictable A=-2h-1.
If d is h-measurable and E[e|h]=0, conditional gain is instead nonpositive.
derivations.scope: Constructive distinction; NF2 does not establish either condition in Wan.
derivations.implication: Preserve action-value routing as conditional candidate; do not restart generic output heads.

derivations.claim: A linear head on standardized fixed h can be folded into the existing readout in real arithmetic.
assumptions: Frozen h, affine standardization and linear output head
derivations.scope: Not native BF16/cast equivalence; no new model speed result.
derivations.implication: Use a cost-matched compensation control, not a third main capacity route.

novelty.mechanism_link: Projection, conditional expectation and quadratic channel selection are known mathematical/methodological components. Potential Wan-specific support/compensation and action-value effects remain unobserved. Independent derivation recorded before new prior-art lookup.

nearest_prior_art.comparison: Quadratic channel coupling/resource-aware selection precedes R4; no claim to invent it.
Diffusion timestep-sensitive pruning precedes this review; no transfer guarantee to current fixed Wan object.
Affine folding plus nonlinear restoration is prior art; kept as backlog transfer.

decisions.reason: Scoped inequalities, identities and counterexamples settle invalid general claims; synthetic checks are not model evidence.
R3 sequential selection alone does not prove support opportunity; control for compensation redundancy.
Output-readout failure does not logically imply action-value failure, but actual conditional value must be established.
Current task authorizes deduction and repository publication; model experiments remain paused, and worker binding was not accessed.

branches.failure: Even the best saved two-arm imaging mixture cannot meet supplementary20 threshold.
branches.lesson: A better selector cannot repair an inadequate fixed action set.

branches.failure: Frozen support gain can disappear under matched existing-feature compensation.
branches.lesson: Sequential fitting order is a hypothesis source, not proof of untapped structural gain.

branches.failure: A synthetic zero-conditional-mean residual still permits predictable support action gains.
branches.lesson: Do not infer action information from output-readout losses alone.

branches.failure: Two individually losing swaps may jointly improve.
branches.lesson: Keep interaction-aware finite proposals; do not call singleton failures a global impossibility.
